text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By competing against Silence Suzuka in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, it seems Manhattan Cafe 
was able to get even closer to her 
"friend."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe caught a glimpse beyond the 
limit. Agnes Tachyon was shaken by the 
description of that sight, frustrated that 
she could not witness it with her own 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe felt that running alongside 
Silence Suzuka and Special Week was the 
guidance of her "friend."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after giving up on going overseas, 
her "friend" continues to guide her... 
What this truly means remains unknown for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it was certain that "friends" 
still existed. Therefore, instead of an 
overseas expedition, her next race was 
decided to be the "Japan Cup."
